source.source_title: Product fiche concerning the Commission Delegated Regulations (EU) No 811/2013 and (EU) No 813/2013 — Grant Aerona³ HPID17R32
source.verification_notes: The model-specific Grant product fiche, current Grant product-page row, matching Heat Pump KEYMARK subtype page and certificate were opened and transcribed. The exact model identity and declared test data were checked. The current product page says two models are available but its table lists four; the market status of HPID13R32 and HPID17R32 is unresolved. Product-page and test-data values are retained separately where their conditions/definitions differ. Seasonal efficiency values are not identical between the manufacturer fiche and KEYMARK record; the differences are documented in record_notes.

extraction.note: Archival-first-pass V2 record. Manufacturer and KEYMARK evidence are preserved in separate Markdown files. No normalized specifications have been added; availability and source differences remain explicit.

sections.heading: Heat Pump KEYMARK certificate — conformity assessment
sections.source_text: Certificate holder Grant Engineering Ireland ULC; manufacturing site Shimonoseki City, Japan; product type Air / Water Heat Pump; sub-type and model Aerona³ HPID17R32; testing standards EN 14511:2018, EN 14825:2018 and EN 12102:2017; KEYMARK Certification Scheme for Heat Pumps (2021); registration 041-K005-04; issue date 1 March 2022; no expiry date stated on the one-page PDF.

record_notes: Archival-first-pass record; no normalized_specifications have been added.

The current Grant product page says two Aerona³ models are available (6kW and 10kW), while its specification table also lists HPID13R32 and HPID17R32. Current market availability of HPID17R32 is not established by the page text.

The current Grant product page lists HPID17R32 capacity 13.6 kW and power input 2.59 kW; the model-specific Grant product fiche lists Prated 12.2 kW at 55°C and 12.8 kW at 35°C, while KEYMARK lists EN14511 heat output 18 kW/15.3 kW and electrical input 3.77 kW/4.86 kW. These are distinct published values/conditions and must not be reconciled by assumption.
The product page reports SCOP 35°C 4.54; KEYMARK reports SCOP 4.61 low-temperature and 3.64 medium-temperature. These are retained separately and not treated as equivalent.
The KEYMARK certificate PDF shows issue date 1 March 2022 but no expiry date; current validity must be checked in the live database.
The KEYMARK database displays refrigerant mass with a decimal comma; the raw string is preserved without numeric conversion.
The certificate PDF's lack of a displayed expiry date is not proof of expiry or current validity; recheck the live KEYMARK status.

The Grant manufacturer fiche reports seasonal space-heating efficiency ηs of 143% at 55°C and 182% at 35°C; the KEYMARK subtype page reports 142% and 181% respectively. Both source values are preserved; no preferred value is selected.
